label: Ubiquiti UniFi BeaconHD (UAP-BeaconHD)
description: UniFi BeaconHD mesh AP: 5 GHz 4x4 1.7 Gbps and 2.4 GHz 2x2 300 Mbps, AC wall-plug powered, Bluetooth management, no Ethernet ports.
notes: Vendor figures from the UniFi BeaconHD techspecs page: 5 GHz **4x4 1.7 Gbps**, 2.4 GHz **2x2 300 Mbps**, max 11.5 W, **universal AC input 100-240 V** - it plugs into a wall socket. **There is no Ethernet port at all**, and the management row lists **Bluetooth** only: it is a pure mesh node, so it cannot be wired, cannot be PoE-powered and cannot be provisioned over the network. In a topology it is reachable only through the wireless mesh and whatever the radio carries.
